comments.text:
Implement ADSREnvelope and ADEnvelope composite Vizia views.

DEPENDS ON: i7-49c.7 (SynthKnob/SynthFader)

ADSR_ENVELOPE: Shows 4 faders (A/D/S/R) with an SVG-like envelope curve visualization above them. Optional extra fader (e.g. Depth). The curve is drawn using Canvas, connecting: origin → attack peak → decay → sustain level → release to zero.

AD_ENVELOPE: Simplified 2-fader version (Attack/Decay) with optional extra, and a simpler A/D curve.

Both support compact mode (shorter faders).

REFERENCE:
- web/src/synth-ui/ADSREnvelope.tsx: full implementation with SVG curve path generation
- web/src/synth-ui/ADEnvelope.tsx: simplified version

Place in crates/integral-vst/src/views/.

title: VST/Vizia: implement ADSREnvelope and ADEnvelope visualizations
